title: The Cage Cart
text: A slaver's cart sits abandoned in the ruts, its cages empty, its doors hanging open. Names are scratched into the bars from inside, dozens of them, some in children's hands. One of them is a Scion's, and the scratches are still fresh.

options.label: Follow the cart's ruts to whoever took them.

outcomes.text: To the slavers' camp, and the slavers, who are not glad to see you.

options.label: The wisest reads all the names.

outcomes.text: Where they were sold, and to whom, and for how little.
It burns high and black. The slavers will see the smoke, and know someone is coming.
